setting.label: 1923 CE · one June day in London
setting.note: Both manuscripts explicitly place the main London day in June 1923 and distinguish it from publication in 1925. Memories and war experiences reach into earlier years.

description: Analyzes Mrs Dalloway through shared clock time and subjective memory, free indirect discourse, the parallel lives of Clarissa and Septimus, medical authority, hospitality and class. Examines Sally and Peter’s place in Clarissa’s memories, women’s opportunities, imperial London, and the ethical limits of interpreting other people’s lives.
